title: Lore pane v1: links panel, forward history and a Query tab (DEC-193 mod slice of LCLI-671)
description:
Mod slice of LCLI-671, split out under DEC-193 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1005). Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/lore-pane-links-and-graph-design.md, section "v1, for 0.14.0: text first, every surface".

The pane's v1, in the lore pane mod this repository ships:
1. A Links panel beside the document on the Read tab, built from `lore graph <id> --depth 1 --limit N --json`: "Links to" (outbound) and "Linked from" (inbound), grouped by edge kind, with supersession shown separately; each neighbour is a Button so it is keyboard-reachable (Tab moves, Enter opens, the first nine take digit hotkeys); and it fills the pane's empty `ConceptDoc.links`.
2. Forward history, beside Back.
3. A Query tab with three panels, each with explicit limits and "truncated" or "complete" shown on every answer: Path (`lore path <from> <to> --max-depth 6 --limit 5`, each step a Button), Impact (`lore impact <id> --direction in|out`), and Orphans (`lore orphans`).
4. The dashboard tool gains an optional `tab: "query"`, so "/lore dashboard" opens straight to a query.

NOT in 0.14.0: a drawn graph (dagre or graphology as Raster or Svg), a Graphviz Image, and a lore explorer handoff.

It consumes the CLI slice's `--limit`; report issues with this design to opum-doc; make no design calls.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Read tab carries a Links panel built from lore graph <id> --depth 1 --limit N --json, with outbound and inbound neighbours grouped by edge kind and supersession shown separately, every neighbour keyboard-reachable, and ConceptDoc.links filled.
A Query tab offers Path, Impact and Orphans, each with explicit limits and truncated/complete shown on every answer.
The dashboard tool accepts an optional tab: "query" and opens straight to the Query tab.
